description: Local-first persistent memory for coding agents. Plain markdown versioned by git is the source of truth; the SQLite FTS5 index and optional local Ollama embeddings are derived and rebuildable. Hybrid keyword + semantic retrieval fused with RRF, degrading to keyword-only when offline. Secrets redacted before every write. Also ships Claude Code SessionStart/SessionEnd hooks.

commands: claude mcp add mem0ry4ai -- python3 /absolute/path/to/mem.py mcp

notes: Fully local; no API keys, no cloud service, no telemetry.
